name: smoke-op
description: Verification-harness bring-up smoke: one nfet_03v3 at gate=vdd, single typical process corner. Not a Toaster block.
claim: None -- harness self-verification, not a spec claim. Proves the PDK model include, corner .lib section, .temp and vdd_val substitution actually take effect, so later records against ratified spec lines can be trusted.

id_nfet_ua.description: gate-tied nfet_03v3 drain current (W/L=10u/1u, Vgs=Vds=vdd) stays in a plausible band at every point. Deliberately wide: it must hold across -40..125 C and +/-10% supply. Corner switching itself is proven by the harness negative control: python3 -m harness.cli selftest smoke-op --corners mos

notes: Smoke experiment: deliberately a single process corner (tt). A recorded run is therefore a subset of the mandated PVT matrix and needs --subset-reason; the Makefile's smoke target supplies it.
gf180mcu is a 3.3 V core process (no 1.8 V device exists); the supply here is the block's device voltage pending ratification in spec/.
